context_evidence.claim: Increasing HBM stack depth intensifies internal heat accumulation and thermo-mechanical stress, so thermal and mechanical constraints should be investigated together.
Advanced HBM thermal management should be considered together with materials, interfaces, package architecture, and reliability rather than optimized as an isolated thermal problem.

hypotheses.text: ECS-TTL embedded cooling shows verified evidence of benefit for Electrical / signal integrity, but its suitability for this case remains unverified for Cost / yield.
hypotheses.validation: Collect direct evidence or design a simulation/experiment that evaluates ECS-TTL embedded cooling against Cost / yield under the target HBM conditions.

hypotheses.text: interface/material optimization shows verified evidence of benefit for Stack / interconnect integration, Thermo-mechanical reliability, but its suitability for this case remains unverified for Thermal performance, Cost / yield.
hypotheses.validation: Collect direct evidence or design a simulation/experiment that evaluates interface/material optimization against Thermal performance, Cost / yield under the target HBM conditions.

hypotheses.text: plugged sidewall shows verified evidence of benefit for Thermal performance, Stack / interconnect integration, but its suitability for this case remains unverified for Manufacturability, Electrical / signal integrity, Cost / yield.
hypotheses.validation: Collect direct evidence or design a simulation/experiment that evaluates plugged sidewall against Manufacturability, Electrical / signal integrity, Cost / yield under the target HBM conditions.
